market_outlook.short_term: Volatile. Warsh hawkish tone and Iran War create two-sided risk: oil up, equities pressured, bonds sold off. Apple transition (Sept 9) and Shein IPO add event risk. Expect 3-5% equity volatility over 4-6 weeks. Gold range-bound $3,200-3,500. Oil elevated on supply concerns.
market_outlook.long_term: Constructive but bifurcated. AI infrastructure and energy transition (Caterpillar power gen) drive structural growth. Housing affordability and consumer inflation cap broad market upside. Fed policy normalization (not cuts) keeps rates elevated through 2027. Geopolitical fragmentation (Iran, Taiwan, Iceland-EU) adds persistent risk premium.
